summary_zh: 本页为绘本的章节标题页，显示“第二十四个故事”，背景为浅蓝色，无其他内容。

page_text_ocr_zh:
一只小土拨鼠今天特别勤快，他洗了满满一桶衣服，有裤子，有衬衫，有短袖，有小背心，还有两条花手绢。
门外的阳光真好，他想把衣服晾在森林边上。
小土拨鼠把装满衣服的木桶提到森林边上。他找来一根绳子，把它拴在林边的两根粗大的柱子上，绳子上晾满自己花花绿绿的衣服。
page_text_en:
A little groundhog was especially hardworking today. He washed a full bucket of clothes—pants, shirts, short sleeves, little vests, and even two floral handkerchiefs.

The sunshine outside was so nice. He wanted to hang his clothes by the forest edge.

The groundhog carried the bucket full of clothes to the forest edge. He found a rope and tied it to two thick posts by the woods. Then he hung all his colorful clothes on the rope.
summary_zh: 小土拨鼠洗完衣服后，将它们晾晒在森林边的绳子上。

page_text_ocr_zh:
晾好衣服，小土拨鼠提着空木桶，
唱着开心的歌回家了。

“这小东西就这么走了？”“柱子”
居然开口说起话来，可是小土拨鼠没有听到。

原来，刚才小土拨鼠把绳子拴在
了大象的两条腿上，他以为那是两根
柱子呢。
page_text_en:
After hanging up the clothes, the little ground squirrel carried the empty bucket home, singing a happy song.

"This little thing just left like that?" "Pillar" 
actually started talking, but the little ground squirrel didn't hear it.

Turns out, just now the little ground squirrel had tied the rope to 
the elephant's two legs, thinking they were two 
pillars.
summary_zh: 小土拨鼠晾完衣服后开心回家，却不知自己把晾衣绳拴在了大象的腿上，大象误以为是柱子，开口说话但小土拨鼠没听见。

page_text_ocr_zh:
大象本来想在这儿站一会儿就赶路的，现在他没法走动了。小土拨鼠的绳子是很细很细的，大象可以挣断绳子赶路，可是，这样一来，绳子上的衣服就全掉在地上，大象再一迈腿，衣服就会被踩得脏脏烂烂的。

“小土拨鼠洗干净这些衣服很不容易。”大象低头看了一下，“要是我把衣服弄脏了、踩烂了，小土拨鼠明天就会没有衣服穿。”
page_text_en:
The elephant originally wanted to stand here for a while and then continue on his way, but now he couldn't move. The little groundhog's rope was very thin. The elephant could break the rope and go, but then all the clothes on the rope would fall to the ground. If he took another step, the clothes would be trampled and become dirty and torn.

"It's not easy for the little groundhog to wash these clothes," the elephant looked down. "If I dirty them or step on them and ruin them, the little groundhog won't have any clothes to wear tomorrow."
summary_zh: 大象被小土拨鼠晾衣绳绊住，无法动弹。他意识到如果自己动弹，会弄脏或踩烂小土拨鼠洗好的衣服，因此决定不动，表现出善良和体贴。

page_text_ocr_zh:
大象只好一动不动地站着。
这时，有只小兔子跑来，他见大象一动也不动地站着，就说：“大象先生，你站在这儿想事吗？”
“不，我什么都没想。不过，你瞧瞧，粗心的小土拨鼠把我的两条腿当柱子，他在这里晾了那么多的衣服。”
小兔子一看，不由得哈哈大笑起来。
page_text_en:
The elephant could only stand still.
At this moment, a little rabbit ran over. Seeing the elephant standing motionless, he said, "Mr. Elephant, are you thinking about something here?"
"No, I'm not thinking about anything. But look, the careless little groundhog took my two legs for pillars and hung so many clothes here."
The little rabbit looked and couldn't help bursting into laughter.
summary_zh: 小兔子发现大象一动不动地站着，以为他在思考，后来得知大象是被小土拨鼠晾衣绳绊住，把腿当柱子，于是忍不住大笑起来。

page_text_ocr_zh:
不过，他很同情好心的大象。小兔子心想：大象这样一动不动地站着挺闷的，我为大家讲故事吧。
小兔子把他肚子里的故事都翻了出来，他一连给大象讲了二十三个故事。
小土拨鼠才挎着竹篮子来收晾干的衣服。
小土拨鼠看见小兔子好像在给谁讲故事。
他抬头一看，眼前站着一头有着大大脑袋、大大耳朵和长长鼻子的大象。再一看，
page_text_en:
But he felt sorry for the kind elephant. The little rabbit thought: The elephant is standing still like this, it must be boring. I'll tell stories for everyone.
The little rabbit pulled all the stories out of his belly and told the elephant twenty-three stories in a row.
The little groundhog came with his bamboo basket to collect the dried clothes.
The little groundhog saw the little rabbit seemed to be telling stories to someone.
He looked up and saw an elephant standing before him, with a big head, big ears, and a long nose. Then he looked again,
summary_zh: 小兔子为被晾衣绳绊住的大象讲故事，小土拨鼠前来收衣服时看到这一幕，抬头看见大象并准备继续观察。

page_text_ocr_zh:
自己把衣服晾在了大象的两条腿上。
小土拨鼠不好意思地叫了起来，
说：“我太粗心了，大象先生，真对不起！我是一只糊涂的小土拨鼠……”
“不，你是一只勤快的、挺有趣的小土拨鼠！”大象说。
小土拨鼠连忙收下衣服，解下绳子。他摸摸自己口袋里还有三块糖，他
把糖都送给了大象，说：“对不起，这点儿糖对一头大象来说是太少了。”
“不，”大象说，“是太多了！”
大象把一块糖给了勤快的小土拨鼠，再分一块糖给很会
讲故事的小兔子。
page_text_en:
He hung his clothes on the elephant's two legs.
The little groundhog called out embarrassedly,
saying, "I'm so careless, Mr. Elephant, I'm really sorry! I'm a silly little groundhog..."
"No, you're a hardworking and quite interesting little groundhog!" said the elephant.
The little groundhog hurriedly took down his clothes and untied the rope. He patted his pocket and found three candies left. He
handed all the candies to the elephant, saying, "I'm sorry, this little bit of candy is too little for a big elephant."
"No," said the elephant, "it's too much!"
The elephant gave one candy to the hardworking little groundhog, and then shared another candy with the very good story-telling little rabbit.
summary_zh: 小土拨鼠因粗心将衣服晾在大象腿上，事后主动道歉并把糖送给大象。大象友善地回应，并将糖分给小土拨鼠和讲故事的小兔子，展现了宽容与分享的美德。

page_text_ocr_zh:
好朋友们吃着糖。
小兔子说：“你们还想听我讲故事吗？”
“当然愿意！”大象和小土拨鼠高兴地说。
小兔子开始讲第二十四个故事了，这个故事叫——
一只在大象腿上晾衣服的小土拨鼠。

page_text_en:
The friends were eating candy.
Little rabbit said, "Do you still want to hear me tell a story?"
"Of course we do!" the elephant and the little groundhog said happily.
Little rabbit began telling the twenty-fourth story. This story is called—
A little groundhog who hung clothes on the elephant's leg.
